Author: monkdim
Name: Maple's Echo
Description: Displays a Discord channel's live voice-to-text callouts inside FFXIV, in a dedicated, fully customizable accessibility window. One-way relay (Discord to game). No fork needed — install, then enter your own Discord bot token and channel in settings. See the README for the one-time Discord setup.
Punchline: An in-game accessibility window for Discord voice-to-text callouts.
